title: 第5章 师妹可有道侣第6章 吃软饭真香
slug: 修真废柴我的系统有点猛
lines: “藏书阁？”
林清雪一双杏眼瞬间瞪得溜圆，像听到了什么不可思议的事情。
“大师兄，你……你要去藏书阁？去做什么？”
在她的印象中。
从他入门开始这位大师兄除了偶尔去山脚坊市兜售他那些“胡编乱造”
的话本。
就是窝在落霞峰他那间破茅屋里混吃等死，对修炼相关的一切都兴趣缺缺。
今天太阳打西边出来了？
姚德龙脸上露出一丝恰到好处的羞赧和固执：
“师兄……师兄想看看有没有什么……适合的武技练练。”
他顿了顿，补充道，
“还有或许……学点旁门左道，比如炼丹什么的…也好……也好补贴点家用。”
“武技？炼丹？”
林清雪看着姚德龙那张写满“晚年奋发”
的老脸，先是愕然。
随后“噗嗤”
一声笑了出来，清脆的笑声在晨光中荡漾。
她笑着笑着，那双灵动的大眼睛里却渐渐蒙上了一层水汽。
她想起了小时候，是眼前这个平庸略显窝囊的大师兄。
用那些光怪陆离、精彩绝伦的故事，给自己枯燥的童年带来了多少欢乐和想象。
师兄虽然修炼不行，可他的故事……那是真好听啊！
“大师兄……”
林清雪的声音柔软下来，带着一丝不易察觉的哽咽。
“你……这是开窍了？”
她上前一步，很自然的拉起姚德龙枯瘦的胳膊。
“走，今天师妹带你去，正好我也没什么事！”
坐着，还没得他反应，纤手一挥，一道流光闪过。
一柄通体晶莹、散发着丝丝寒气的飞剑悬浮在林晴雪面前。
剑身微微颤动，发出悦耳的鸣响。
“师…师妹？这……飞剑！”
姚德龙看着眼前的飞剑，双腿有点发软。
前世骑电驴的被撞的经历，加速他这低微的修为，是既害怕又憧憬！
“对啊，难道师兄你要走过去？那不得天黑都到不了！”
林清雪俏皮一笑，身姿轻盈的跃上飞剑，对着姚德龙伸出手。
“师兄，快上来吧，我载你！”
看着伸向自己的纤纤玉手，姚德龙咽了口唾沫，心一横，闭眼抓着林清雪的手。
入手温软细腻，让他心头一荡。
他笨拙的爬上飞剑，整个人摇摇晃晃，如风中残烛一般。
content_en:
"Library?"
Lin Qingxue's almond-shaped eyes suddenly widened, as if she had heard something incredible.
"Elder brother, you...you want to go to the Library Pavilion? What are you going to do?"
in her mind.
From the time he started, this senior brother only occasionally went to Shanjiaofang City to sell his "nonsense fabrications"
The storybook.
He just lived in his shabby hut at Luoxia Peak, eating and waiting to die, showing little interest in anything related to cultivation.
Does the sun come out in the west today?
Yao Delong's face showed just the right amount of shyness and stubbornness:
"Senior brother...Senior brother wants to see if there is any...suitable martial arts practice."
He paused and added,
"Also maybe... learn some sideline methods, such as alchemy or something... maybe... maybe to help support the family."
"Martial skills? Alchemy?"
Lin Qingxue looked at Yao Delong's photo with "Work hard in his later years" written all over it.
His old face was stunned at first.
Then "poof!"
A laugh broke out, and the clear laughter rippled in the morning light.
She smiled, but her big and lively eyes were gradually covered with a layer of moisture.
She remembered the mediocre and somewhat useless elder brother in front of her when she was a child.
With those bizarre and wonderful stories, he brought so much joy and imagination to his boring childhood.
Although my senior brother is not good at cultivation, his story... is really nice!
"Elder brother..."
Lin Qingxue's voice softened, with a hint of unnoticeable choking.
"You...are you enlightened?"
She took a step forward and naturally took Yao Delong's skinny arm.
"Let's go, junior sister will take you there today, and I happen to have nothing to do!"
Sitting there, before he could react, he waved his delicate hand and a stream of light flashed past.
A flying sword that was crystal clear and exuded a hint of cold air was suspended in front of Lin Qingxue.
The sword trembled slightly and made a pleasant sound.
"Master...junior sister? This...flying sword!"
Yao Delong looked at the flying sword in front of him, his legs felt a little weak.
The experience of being hit while riding an e-donkey in his previous life accelerated his low level of cultivation. He was both afraid and longing for it!
"Yes, senior brother, are you going to walk there? You won't be able to get there even after dark!"
Lin Qingxue smiled playfully, jumped onto the flying sword lightly, and stretched out her hand towards Yao Delong.
"Brother, come up quickly, I'll take you!"
Looking at the slender hand stretched out to him, Yao Delong swallowed, his heart skipped a beat, and he closed his eyes and grabbed Lin Qingxue's hand.
It was soft and delicate, which made his heart skip a beat.
He clumsily climbed onto the flying sword, his whole body swaying like a candle in the wind.
